summary.text: Kimberly Thomas is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 33, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kimberly Thomas was the Republican candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 33 in 2024, when incumbents Peter Leishman and Jonah Wheeler, both Democrats, defeated her in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.
